environment.description: Container deployed via Kubernetes with pod security context specifying readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. The container image uses a distroless base with no shell. Volume mounts are limited to a single ConfigMap at /etc/cicd-plugin/ (mounted ro). No PersistentVolumeClaim, emptyDir, or tmpfs volumes are attached to the pod. The container's securityContext also sets allowPrivilegeEscalation: false and drops ALL capabilities. Pod runs in a namespace with ResourceQuota preventing ephemeral storage allocation.
